name: hit_stone
for: a blow on stone (Statue Archangel, Radiant Construct, rune sentinel, walls)
notes: Grey crack-flash, chunkier stone chips plus a spray of fine grit that rain down and settle on the floor 74 px below, a grey grit cloud. Same staging as hit_bone in a cold grey stone palette with more, smaller grit. 12 frames @ 12 fps.
